articleBodyHtml:
Speaker's Cooking Technique

The speaker explains that making rows is her only method of cooking and that she is accustomed to it. She acknowledges that people might be surprised by her technique, especially regarding her fingers, but reassures the audience that she is used to it. She emphasizes that this is the only way she can cook and asks for respect for her method. She also mentions that she is careful and finds the process efficient, resulting in small onion pieces.

New Kitchen Tools and Techniques

The speaker is trying out a new kitchen tool, which she previously did not use. She is making an effort to incorporate it into her cooking routines, such as adjusting the ratio of tomatoes and onions. She also mentions that she is not sponsored and bought the tool herself, but recommends it for people who find sharpening knives difficult. She prefers an easy and quick method rather than learning the whole process of sharpening a knife on her own.

Future Plans and Content Sharing

The speaker mentions that she will be checking out content in four and a half hours, which will be available on her YouTube channel and possibly other platforms. She also plans to read super chats at the end of her stream.
